titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 8/2009 (ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޕެންޝަން ޤާނޫނު) އަށް ... ވަނަ އިސްލާހު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Maldives Pension Act (Law No. 8/2009). It adds two new articles, numbered 32-1 and 32-2, straight after Article 32. The new articles refer back to Article 19 of the Act and set out rules that include a fixed amount of MVR 2,000 and a time limit of 3 months, which appear to be about penalties or obligations around pension payments. The scans are hard to read, so some details are uncertain.
whyItMatters: If it had passed, it would have added new enforceable rules to the pension system, which covers the retirement savings of ordinary workers and their employers. The bill was rejected by a vote, so none of this took effect.
keyProvisions: Clause 1 inserts new Articles 32-1 and 32-2 after Article 32 of the Pension Act.
Article 32-1 refers to Article 19 of the Act and sets out a rule tied to that article.
Article 32-2 is split into numbered sub-paragraphs (1) to (3) under paragraph (a), and further paragraphs after that. One of the sub-paragraphs sets a fixed amount of MVR 2,000.
Two later paragraphs of Article 32-2 refer to a period of 3 months.
Clause 2 is a short commencement clause, saying when the amendment takes effect once it is ratified and published.
whoIsAffected: Employers and workers covered by the Maldives Pension Act, and the body that runs the pension scheme.
statedReasons: An explanatory note is printed on page 2, but the scan was too hard to read for the reasons to be stated reliably.
